summary: All 26 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes, and all nine computations reproduced. Figure 7a shows 319 upregulated and 68 downregulated genes under the adjusted-P rule. The notebook’s nominal-P rule gives 360 and 92. The corrected proposal documents the discrepancies in normalization and P-value adjustment, clarifies the tissue sampled, and distinguishes the Gbp2 count-replacement check from a model refit. The needs_author_contact closure is justified.
openIssues: The deposited day-five analysis used 14 vehicle mice, while the paper reports seven. Author confirmation is needed to establish when GSM4646998–GSM4647004 were labelled Non-Diabetic, which met the pretreatment glucose criterion, and which controls Figure 7a was intended to represent.
